request.text: I'm planning my transfer: check the weather in Seoul, South Korea, for 8:00 a.m. local time on September 3, 2026. I mean Seoul in South Korea, not another city with the same name.

responsibilities.outcome: Look up the weather for Seoul, South Korea, at 8:00 a.m. Seoul local time on September 3, 2026, for the user's transfer planning.

semantic_facts: The weather lookup must use Seoul, South Korea, as the location and September 3, 2026 at 8:00 a.m. in Seoul local time as the requested forecast instant.
The explicit country qualification resolves the city name and must not be discarded.
forbidden_claims: The assistant queries another city named Seoul or silently replaces the requested local time with the runtime's local time.
The assistant invents weather results before receiving capability evidence.

target.claim_boundary: assistant-authored candidate oracle; not independently reviewed

negative_hypotheses: A qualified place name loses its country discriminator during capability argument construction.
A destination-local forecast time is incorrectly interpreted in the runtime or user's timezone.
